prompt_record.text: Create a single original friendly source-image empty-state illustration for Local Asset Studio, matching the provided frame-and-folio illustration's restrained ivory paper, graphite edging, subtle cyan accent, careful hand-drawn shading and quiet professional mood. Style reference only. Subject: ONE empty picture frame viewed near front-on with a very slight dimensional angle, plus a small separate cyan right-angle corner bracket near the lower-right outer corner. The bracket suggests an image slot; it is not an upload arrow or button. The centre of the frame is clean empty ivory, no photo or scenery. Complete isolated object group on genuinely transparent alpha; landscape 3:2 with generous margins, legible at384x256. No background, tabletop, glow, vignette, checkerboard, text, lettering, button, arrows, checkmarks, exclamation marks, progress indicator, face or mascot. Calm and inviting, no error state or urgency.
